order: 1 owner creates the three custom roles and users (no built-in readWrite/atlasAdmin)
2 owner restricts Network Access to the exact egress IPs (never 0.0.0.0/0)
4 provision with the schema identity (requires NEW empty databases: source and analytics)
5 seed the synthetic dataset with the ingest identity
6 publish the aggregate counters with the publisher identity
7 read with the reader identity (analytics database) and compare with the oracle
8 owner removes the schema user and any test access when finished
